places.name: La Mar Cebichería
places.description: Gastón Acurio's vibrant daytime-only cevichería serving ultra-fresh catches from the Peruvian coast in a lively, open-air courtyard.
places.highlight: Cebiche Clásico & Nigiri Anticuchero

places.name: Isolina Taberna Peruana
places.description: A cozy, nostalgic tavern housed in a 1906 Barranco mansion that revives generous, slow-cooked traditional Lima comfort food meant for sharing.
places.highlight: Lomo Saltado & Seco de Asado de Tira

places.name: Maido
places.description: Internationally acclaimed fine-dining destination led by Chef Mitsuharu Tsumura, blending Japanese culinary precision with Amazonian and Andean ingredients.
places.highlight: 50-Hour Braised Beef Short Rib (Asado de Tira Nitsuke)

places.name: Panchita
places.description: Warm, bustling dining room celebrating Peru's wood-fired grill traditions, hearty stews, and classic street snacks elevated to perfection.
places.highlight: Anticuchos de Corazón & Causa Limeña

places.name: El Pan de la Chola
places.description: Artisanal sourdough bakery and casual café famous for naturally leavened breads, organic coffee, and fresh open-faced sandwiches.
places.highlight: Avocado & Poached Egg Sourdough Toast

places.name: Canta Rana
places.description: A beloved, no-frills neighborhood cevichería covered in football memorabilia and vintage posters, known for bold flavors and huge portions.
places.highlight: Ceviche Apaltado (with avocado) & Causa de Cangrejo

places.name: Tanta
places.description: Modern, family-friendly bistro offering an expansive menu of Peruvian classics, fusion pastas, and show-stopping traditional desserts.
places.highlight: Ají de Gallina & Suspiro a la Limeña

places.name: Bar Cordano
places.description: Operating since 1905 right beside the Government Palace, this historic salon preserves old-world Lima charm with classic sandwiches and Chilcanos.
places.highlight: Pan con Butifarra & Pisco Chilcano

places.name: Siete Sopas
places.description: A wildly popular local hotspot serving a different rotating traditional Peruvian soup each day of the week alongside rotisserie chicken.
places.highlight: Sopa Criolla & Pollo a la Brasa

places.name: La Lucha Sanguchería Criolla
places.description: Iconic quick-service sandwich counter near Kennedy Park serving roasted pork sandwiches on crusty French rolls with hand-cut Huayro potato fries.
places.highlight: Pan con Chicharrón & Lúcuma Milkshake

places.name: Malecón de Miraflores Walk & Paragliding
places.description: Stroll along six miles of cliffside parks overlooking the Pacific Ocean, passing El Parque del Amor and Faro La Marina, or launch into a tandem paraglide.
places.highlight: Visit just before sunset for golden-hour ocean views

places.name: Puente de los Suspiros & Barranco Street Art
places.description: Explore Lima's bohemian arts district, cross the wooden Bridge of Sighs, follow the Bajada de Baños walkway to the sea, and admire vibrant murals.
places.highlight: Hold your breath while crossing the bridge for the first time to make a wish

places.name: Plaza Mayor & San Francisco Catacombs
places.description: Discover Lima's colonial heart surrounded by ornate wooden balconies, the Cathedral, and the underground bone catacombs beneath the Monasterio de San Francisco.
places.highlight: Watch the Changing of the Guard at the Government Palace around noon

places.name: Huaca Pucllana Archaeological Site
places.description: Tour a massive 1,500-year-old adobe and clay pyramid built by the pre-Inca Lima culture, remarkably preserved right in the middle of a modern residential neighborhood.
places.highlight: Book an evening guided tour to see the pyramid dramatically illuminated

places.name: Circuito Mágico del Agua
places.description: Located in Parque de la Reserva, this Guinness World Record complex features 13 interactive, illuminated fountains synchronized to music and laser projections.
places.highlight: Arrive after 7:00 PM for the main light and music show at Fuente de la Fantasía

places.name: Museo Larco
places.description: Housed in an 18th-century vice-royal mansion surrounded by lush bougainvillea gardens, showcasing 5,000 years of pre-Columbian gold, silver, and ceramics.
places.highlight: Don't miss the open-access storage rooms holding over 30,000 ancient vessels

places.name: Surf Lessons at Costa Verde (Playa Makaha)
places.description: Catch gentle, consistent Pacific waves at Playa Makaha, one of the most accessible urban surf breaks in South America, with board rentals and instructors on the beach.
places.highlight: Wetsuits are included in rentals—the Humboldt Current keeps the water chilly year-round

places.name: Mercado N°1 de Surquillo Food Tour
places.description: Walk through a bustling traditional market steps from Miraflores to sample exotic Amazonian fruits like chirimoya, lúcuma, and camu camu alongside fresh ceviche stalls.
places.highlight: Ask vendors for a taste of granadilla and fresh passionfruit juice

places.name: Parque Kennedy & Artisan Market
places.description: Relax in Miraflores' lively central park famous for its friendly resident cats, street musicians, open-air painters, and surrounding alpaca textile shops.
places.highlight: Grab warm picarones (sweet potato donuts) from the park carts in the late afternoon

places.name: MATE - Museo Mario Testino
places.description: A sleek contemporary photography center in a restored 19th-century Barranco townhouse featuring iconic fashion portraits and traditional Peruvian festival attire.
places.highlight: Check out the Alta Moda room showcasing vibrant traditional Cusco textiles
